provenance.source: Built with scripts/build_stock_head.py from scripts/stock_heads/stock-01.json: Blender 4.5.15 LTS, MPFB 2.0.18, asset packs makehuman_system_assets, faceunits01 and suits02
provenance.notes: MakeHuman base mesh and targets (bundled with MPFB 2.0.18); skin young_caucasian_male, hair short02, eyes high-poly (brown), eyebrow001, eyelashes01, teeth_base, tongue01 (makehuman_system_assets pack, CC0); ARKit face units by Mika Suominen (faceunits01 pack, CC0); uniform thegreatengineer_galactic_warrior_uniform by TheGreatEngineer (suits02 pack, CC0). Phenotype: adult, age macro 0.6. A generated character, not a real person. Revision 2: tongue flattened to lie on the floor of the mouth, and it drops with the chin under jawOpen; upper teeth lowered 2.5 mm; inside of the mouth darkened with vertex colours; mouthPucker scaled 1.5x; teeth texture brightened; brows and lashes blended instead of cut out. Revision 3: wears a high-collared crew uniform.
